description: Paid ($0.02 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger or in USD₮0 on X Layer): audit the open token approvals of a wallet on an EVM chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc) or on Solana, for example your agent's own wallet as a periodic check. Get back green/orange/red, a grade, a one-line summary and every approval with its spender. EVM, every ERC-20 allowance: flagged malicious (red), a plain wallet, on a doubt list, an unverified contract or an unlimited allowance to a spender not on the GoPlus trust list (orange), with a revoke.cash link. Solana, every SPL token delegation (Approve): a delegate on the OFAC SDN list (red), a delegate that is a plain wallet or an unlimited delegation (orange), with the token account to revoke on; Token-2022 tokens with a permanent delegate are listed too. NFT approvals are not covered. Same as GET /v1/approvals. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

address.description: Wallet address (0x... on EVM, base58 on Solana)
